snippet.title: Pollywog shortplay (Apple II - Top-Notch Productions)
snippet.description:
Pollywog (https://www.mobygames.com/game/apple2/pollywog) was an action game published by Top-Notch Productions in 1982 for the Apple ][. The player controls a dozen frog eggs whose goal is to eat up all the green algae, while avoiding being eaten by the orange creepies and the white fish. Once a frog is fully grown, it can eat the creepies using its tongue, but I wasn't able to show that in the video. I think the game is interesting for its use of double low-resolution graphics and good game music using the limited Apple II speaker.

Credits:
Disk image - 4AM
